changeSet.author: dev
changeSet.comment: Rename BONUS to EXTRA in earn_type enum and BONUS_PAID to EXTRA_PAID in financial_log_type enum
changeSet.sql: ALTER TYPE earn_type ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'EXTRA';
UPDATE earnings SET earn_type = 'EXTRA' WHERE earn_type = 'BONUS';
ALTER TYPE financial_log_type ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'EXTRA_PAID';
UPDATE financial_logs SET log_type = 'EXTRA_PAID' WHERE log_type = 'BONUS_PAID';
